canon: Cardo espinoso de tallo rígido y flor cerrada de un gris metálico apagado (con matiz violáceo: decisión de la usuaria, 2026-10-25), con una única fibra central imantada que, colgada de un hilo, siempre señala el mismo rumbo.

prompt.sujeto: An upright, spiky thistle with a stiff, thorny stem as tall as an adult orc's open hand, its grey-green leaves edged with fine thorns.
prompt.cuerpo: At the tip sits a single closed, egg-shaped flower in a dull metallic grey with a faint muted violet tint at its base, with a matte, almost forged sheen.
rasgos: From the centre of the flower a lone rigid, magnetised fibre points steadily in one direction.
A few dark grains of iron sand cling to the thorns, drawn to the plant.
prompt.pose: Two or three of the thistles grow close together in the lee of a field of black magnetic rocks, where wind-combed ridges of dark iron sand pile up.
prompt.entorno: Fine red dust drifts in the air above red clay, and a low, hazy horizon glows behind them.
prompt.luz: Soft morning light falls from behind with a gentle backlight, picking out the metallic sheen of the flower and the thorns.
